content.short: Event Decoder decodes 4-byte or ABI inputs with a calculator, tx decoder, and ctor encoder.
content.description: Event Decoder is a developer-focused toolkit that interprets 4-byte signatures or ABI-encoded data, and bundles practical utilities such as a calculator, a transaction decoder, and a constructor encoder. The calculators help with conversions, calldata decoding, and even vanity address generation for testing scenarios. The project fosters an active community around its tools, with over 100 members contributing ideas, test cases, and documented examples to help users explore and validate smart contract interactions.
